Name: Uncle Iroh Approved Tea
Author: slimerrain
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/Npvb8Ty.png[/img]﻿

- Adds 5 Flowers, 2 Crops, 2 Bushes, and 1 Tree.
- Adds 8 Items.
- Adds 8 Drinks (+ 1 Optional Drink if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20884?tab=files]Grains Overhull[/url].)
- Adds 4 Dishes.
- Adds 1 Machine (Teapot!)

- Works with vanilla Tea Leaves (half the time of keg, but only makes half as much money.)
- NPCs will react to these new items according to their own tastes when gifted,
- Config allows two ways to make the tea (teapot / kitchen / both). (Through the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.)

- Will add better compatibility when people make suggestions in the future (but will work with any other mod that has the same new items & crops.)
- Does not actually add content from Avatar the Last Airbender ( he just approves of my tea [:  ). I will add him to the game in a different mod~
- Yes, it's compatible with:
﻿- Cornucopia
﻿- Quaint Living Flower Garden 2
﻿- Wildflour Atelier Crops
﻿- Tearrific (There's an extra folder you can download for this one.)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GaaG6Wf.png[/img]﻿

Stardew Valley is very lacking in the world of drinks. Here is a new way to brew some relaxing drinks every day!
[img]https://imgur.com/HXxdGIq.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/MVKKgeC.png[/img]﻿
Teapot + Alt. Coloring by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/17838849]uchikunato[/url]! (You can change the color in the Generic Mod Config Menu)

Most of these tea drinks can be brewed in the teapot, which is unlocked at Farming level 2.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tIlWota.png[/img]﻿
In order of image:
[b]Brown Rice Tea[/b] (made from Unmilled Rice) +10 energy, +4 health, +2 speed, 7:00
[b]Cassia Tea[/b] (made from Cassia Seeds)  +10 energy, +4 health, +1 speed, +1 attack, 7:00
[b]Chamomile Tea[/b] (made from Chamomile)  +238 energy, +107 health
[b] Chrysanthemum Tea [/b] (made from Chrysanthemum) +63 energy, +28 health, +40 max energy, +1 speed, +1 defense, 7:00
[b]Health Blend Tea[/b] (made in the kitchen, recipe in Clinic), +250 energy, +112 health, +40 max energy, +2 speed, +1 defense, +1 attack, 21:00; three crafted via cassia tea + chrysanthemum tea + dried Goji
[b]Lavender Tea[/b] (made from Lavender) +13 energy, +5 health, +1 farming, +1 speed, 7:00
[b]Jasmine Tea[/b] (made from Jasmine)  +15 energy, +6 health, +1 foraging, +100 max energy, +2 speed, 7:00
[b]Osmanthus Tea[/b] (made from Osmanthus) +18 energy, +8 health, +2 luck, +2 speed, 3:30
(Last one is the optional Barley Tea (made from Barley) if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20884?tab=files]Grains Overhull[/url] installed.) +188 energy, +84 health, +2 fishing, +1 speed, 7:00

﻿To install and use the Uncle Iroh Approved Tea mod, do the following:
  
1. Prerequisites:[list]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*] ﻿Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿
[*] ﻿Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]Custom Bush[/url]
[*] ﻿Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ (Optional)
[/list]
2. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22376]Uncle Iroh Approved Tea[/url].

3. ﻿Extract the following folders from the downloaded zip file into your Mods folder:[list]
[*] ﻿[CP] Uncle Iroh Approved Tea
[*] ﻿Byproducts for Uncle Iroh Approved Tea
[/list]
[To Uninstall, remove any of the crops from the field, trash any of the items and seeds in your inventory, and then delete the three mod folders extracted into the Mods folder.]
